source: ENISA Space Threat Landscape 2025, Annex C Table 17 (via Phalanx/framework/enisa_threats_tuple.csv)
name: Lack of segregation
description: Although uncommon, it is possible that a satellite does not have built-in bus-payload segregation, or that segregation is implemented improperly. If these two asset subdomains are not segregated, potential materialization of threats to the satellite bus can impact a wider set of assets, including the satellite payload.

projection.lifecycle_rule: ET-P-LC-01 (legacy tuple L field; Annex C has no lifecycle column)

derivation_provenance.note: candidate_lifecycle copies the legacy tuple L field {3,4,5,6,7}; ENISA STL 2025 Annex C has no lifecycle column, so the basis is the legacy tuple, not the Annex

claims.rationale: Bus/payload segregation is exactly the segregation concern SV-AC-6 describes for onboard components.
